title: Introduction to Euclid's Geometry
subtitle: Understanding the Foundations of Geometry
subject: Mathematics
author: AI EduOS
learning_outcomes: Understand the history and origin of geometry.
Learn Euclid's five postulates and apply them.
Understand equivalent versions of Euclid's fifth postulate.

ai_context.learning_goal: Master the foundational axioms and postulates defined by Euclid.
common_misconceptions: Thinking Euclid's fifth postulate is simple or obvious.
Believing a point or line has physical dimensions.
ai_context.tutor_hint: Ask the student: Can you draw a straight line between any two points? If so, which postulate are you using?
